name: Four Seasons Hotel Madrid
positioning: Hotel in seven historic buildings in central Madrid, between Puerta del Sol and Barrio de las Letras
best_for: Travelers who want a central Madrid base with most attractions within a 20-minute walk
Guests who want a rooftop restaurant by chef Dani García and a spa with a 14-metre swimming pool

facts.text: The hotel has 200 rooms in total.
The hotel is at Calle de Sevilla 3, Madrid.
The hotel is between Puerta del Sol and Barrio de las Letras.
The property is comprised of seven historic buildings.
The majority of attractions are within a 20-minute walk.
It's just a 25-minute drive to Madrid-Barajas International Airport.
Dani Brasserie is a rooftop restaurant where chef Dani García blends Michelin-starred technique with more casual Spanish and international dishes.
Isa Restaurant & Cocktail Bar serves modern Asian street food.
El Patio is the hotel's lobby bar.
The spa has 8 treatment rooms including one couple's suite.

highlights.text: The showpiece of the Spa is a 14-metre (46-foot) swimming pool.
The pool has modern glass walls and a skylight the full size of the pool.
In the grand lobby, the city's past is revealed in 3,700 restored artefacts.
Sound-proofing throughout the hotel is state-of-the-art.
The hotel offers works of Spanish contemporary art throughout.

considerations.text: The pool area is reserved for guests ages 12 and over.
The hotel is in a neighborhood still rife with construction sites.
The hotel feels aimed largely at a mature client who likes everything to be just so.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, full breakfast for two is included daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
